Definition: evenness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity or concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) rectitude (only in plural with singular sense; often adverbially)
BiblicalUsage: 1) evenness, uprightness, straightness, equity; 1a) evenness, level, smoothness; 1b) uprightness, equity; 1c) rightly (as adv)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
